## More Information Needed

Before I can calculate the monthly cost for this scheduled batch workload, I need a few additional required inputs. No estimate has been calculated yet.

**Processing (scheduled batch):**

**Other calculator areas** (SQL reporting, DataSync transfer, S3/KMS storage, recurring model API, one-time model jobs): are any of these in scope for this estimate, or should they all be marked **Not Applicable**?

Please provide these values so I can calculate your estimate.

*Note: a 2-hour runtime per run applies to all scenarios (LOW/EXPECTED/HIGH) unless you give separate low/high runtimes.*
